title: fix(metadata-protocol): a package holding a bundle name only through its own stored row lists the pair member its exact read serves (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoMEcsa8u1Ymjwvb5h8WsfW2)_

Refs #33131 (items 4, 5)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — no taught sentence names a package that holds a name only through its own stored row, or the moved-edit reading of a pair row.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：一个包只通过自己存储的一行持有某个邮件模板名（没有代码制品）时，它的列表和执行列表现在也带上 App 的 `.custom` 配对包添加的语言版本，和它的精确读取（`?package=X&member=…`）一致（第 5 项）。第 4 项按裁决 6868829990（选项 A）不改行为，只加一条固定测试，写明这是 #31593 的“迁移后编辑”规则。
- 为什么改：以前同一个包的地址能读到这个语言版本，但它自己的列表里没有，两边说法不一致。
- 风险与回滚：只影响“包仅通过存储行持有一个邮件模板名，且 App 配对包里有未声明的另一语言行”这种罕见组合；有第二个持有者或该行声明了别的包时仍然不列（对照测试已固定）。回滚即还原本 PR，存储数据不变形。
- 先看：`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` 的 `holdsNameForExactRead`，以及 `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` 里配对包添加成员的那条规则。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t "33131|holds the name through"`，两种注册顺序全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## What changes

- **Item 5 — a package's list now agrees with its exact read** (`protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`, `protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`). Package X holds an email template's name only through its own stored row (no code artifact ships it), and its App's `.custom` pair stores an undeclared row of another locale. X's exact read (`?package=X&member=de-DE`) served that locale, since X is the name's sole holder (#32561 contract review n1, pinned UNCHANGED). X's list and the execution list a send resolved to X reads left it out, because the scoped list's added-member rule asked only whether a code package ships the name (`shipsBundleName`). The rule now also asks `holdsNameForExactRead`: whether the registry's served holders (`packageScopedHoldersOf`, the exact read's own count) include X. Every other check is unchanged: `baseServesBundleMember` and `pairMemberWithheldAt` still withhold a row that two holders could own, or that declares another package. Only types whose readers consult `(package, name)`.
- **Item 4 — measured, by design (#31593 moved edit), ruling 6868829990.** A pair row declaring module X (which ships nothing of the name), while module W of the same App ships the member, is the tenant's edit of an item that moved from X to W (`isMovedOverrideRowOf`), so W's address and lists serve it and X's address refuses naming W. No behaviour change; one pin names the rule.
- Semantic entry `stored-row-holder-lists-pair-member` (ADR-0087) and two changesets.

## Red lines

1. **Resolution never loosened.** No new predicate and no new door: the list adopts the exact read's own holder count (`packageScopedHoldersOf`) and keeps every withholding check. Pinned by `[#33131] CONTROL — X holds the name through its own stored row beside a second holder Y (…): X's exact read refuses the undeclared pair row naming both, and X's lists leave it out` and `[#33131] CONTROL — X holds the name through its own stored row, and the pair row declares Y (…): neither X's exact read nor X's lists serve it`, both orders.
2. **Ambiguity reported, never guessed.** With two holders the row is still refused naming both and left out of both lists (the first CONTROL). Item 4 is not a guess introduced here: the ruled #31593 reading is pinned in both orders.
3. **Independently releasable.** The exact read is unchanged (the n1 pin's read assertions are as on `main`); a holder through a composite slot is unchanged (`CONTROL — X holds the name through its composite slot`); every pre-existing pin in `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` stays green. ADR-0087 entry `18.stored-row-holder-lists-pair-member.ts`.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`:
  - the #32561 n1 pin `[#33131] exact read UNCHANGED, lists now agree — X holds the name through its own stored row in the bare slot (holding first / pair row first)` now asserts X's list and execution list are `['pair de-DE', 'suitex en-US']` (FROM: `['suitex en-US']`), as the composite-slot CONTROL beside it already did;
  - two new CONTROLs, both orders (second holder Y; row declaring Y);
  - `[#33131 item 4, by design #31593] a pair row declaring a module that ships nothing of the name is the moved edit of the module that ships it (row stored first / W registered first)`: W's address serves `pair de-DE for X` stamped W, W's list and execution list carry it, the registry item at W is W's own `wolf de-DE`, and X answers 409 naming W.

Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` + `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`, marker present in dist while mutated, absent after, `git status --porcelain` empty after):

| | mutation | red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A5 | `holdsNameForExactRead` off in the list's added-member rule | 2 failed, 6 passed (the two stored-row pins; the CONTROLs stay green) |
| A6 | `isMovedOverrideRowOf` forced false | 2 failed (both item-4 pins) |

## Acceptance notes

- **Item 4** follows ruling 6868829990 (option A): measurement on the card, comment 6868819871. With `isMovedOverrideRowOf` forced false, W's address and both its lists answer W's own `wolf de-DE` in both orders and nothing else moves, so the stored state cannot tell this row from a genuine module-to-module move.
- **Item 5** was re-measured on `main` before the fix, both orders: holders `[suitex, suite.custom]`, `?package=X&member=de-DE` → `pair de-DE`, X's list and execution list `["suitex en-US"]`.
- **Not in this PR:** the both-overridden registry face carried from #33189 (comment 6870666736). It is the registry's one-bare-slot model, not the list's holder count, so it is a different fix; the card stays open for it (`Refs`).
- #32606 is not folded: neither item changes `servedOverlayRowCandidates` for an addition package.
- Declared surface grep (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) on `origin/main`: 62 hits in 3 of 6 files (exact-qualifier 28, list-reads 5, the exact-qualifier test 29). Those beside an edited hunk, each kept: `protocol-exact-qualifier.ts` [epic ruling on #31699 F2] `pairMemberOwners` "⛔ Never a pick between two" and `pairMemberWithheldAt` (both untouched, still asked after the widened holder check; the second-holder CONTROL pins it); `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` [#28802, #28390 ruling A] the pair's added member on the base's address (the rule this extends to a stored-row holder, same polarity).

## Verification

- holders `[com.acme.suitex, com.acme.suite.custom]`; `?package=X&member=de-DE` → `pair de-DE`; X's list and execution list → `["suitex en-US"]`.
